messages:
Alex K.: prod-edge-us-west - seeing a bunch of GPU pods CrashLoopBackOff after scheduling. Runtime logs show TLS handshake timeouts to model-registry.s3.amazonaws.com:443. Can someone check edge ingress SG / NACLs? @Samira @Jordan
Samira: on it. which nodepool?
Alex K.: gpu-edge-pool-3. Affected: runtime-loader-7f8b9c and runtime-fetcher-21a4e. We did a kernel roll earlier but errors look like connection timeouts before TLS.
Jordan: checking SGs and NAT GW routes now, also grabbing iptables logs from node.
infra-bot: alert: high 5xx rate on edge-proxy-us-west (12:03–12:09)
Maria P.: can you paste a curl/tcpdump snippet? also did we change any managed prefix lists for S3 recently?
Alex K.: paste logs:
```
$ curl -v https://model-registry.s3.amazonaws.com/manifest
* Connected to model-registry.s3.amazonaws.com (52.217.45.33) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake timeout
* Closing connection 0
curl: (28) Operation timed out after 10000 milliseconds
```
Samira: I see node ENI SG allows 443 out to 0.0.0.0/0, BUT the ALB ENI has a restrictive SG named `edge-ingress-locked` that only allows outbound to internal CIDR. if ALB is proxying and using its ENI for upstream, that SG could block the connection.
Jordan: found terraform diff in pr #4532 that set `egress = []` on module `edge-ingress-sg` — looks like the default outbound allow got removed. that would cause outbound to be blocked at the SG level.
Samira: confirming infra layout: ALB ENI uses `edge-ingress-locked`. worker nodes egress via NAT GW. but some pulls are initiated from the proxy path where ALB needs to open ephemeral outbound to S3.
Maria P.: quick mitigation options: re-add open outbound to 443 on the ingress SG, or short-circuit to regional mirror. we should patch SG for test.
Ned O.: heads-up: prod SG change needs emergency approval; small exception ok. @ops-oncall please ack.
Jordan: patching SG to add outbound TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 for testing (will record change).
Jordan: patched - added rule outbound TCP 443 0.0.0.0/0 to `edge-ingress-locked`. watching.
infra-bot: metric: token-level lat p95 returning to baseline
Samira: nodes are successfully pulling shards again, pods going to Running.
Alex K.: pods restarted, runtime-loader and runtime-fetcher healthy. thanks all.
Maria P.: PR created to revert #4532 and to add a terraform test that prevents empty egress blocks + a note to not set `egress = []` without explicit intent.
Samira: adding runbook entry: "edge-ingress SG accidentally removes egress -> quick patch & revert". also adding a guard in the terraform CI.
Alex K.: can we also add an automated smoke that attempts S3 manifest fetch from a proxy-backed path after SG changes?
Jordan: yes, adding smoke to deployment pipeline.
infra-bot: incident: resolved. duration 00:18:39
Alex K.: thanks team. will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow. 
Maria P.: :thumbsup:
